summary.text: John Cavanaugh is a member of the Nebraska Legislature (Unicameral) representing District 9, serving since 2020 (elected 2020, re-elected 2024). His committee assignments are General Affairs, Government, Military and Veterans Affairs, and Urban Affairs.

paragraphs.text: According to his legislative biography, Cavanaugh was born October 6, 1980, in Omaha and graduated from Creighton Preparatory School in 1999.
He earned a B.A. from the Catholic University of America in 2003 and a J.D. and an M.A. in environmental policy from Vermont Law School in 2011.
His biography lists his occupation as attorney, with past work as a Douglas County assistant public defender.
It lists him as married to Kathleen McGill, with four children.
